text:
rita (Design): quick check-in on the Private setup connectivity step. getting feedback from the UX lab: copy feels vague and users worry we're doing something intrusive. want to tighten language + surface fallback for strict networks.

chao (UX): agree. users interpret "run checks" as "we'll take actions on your hosts". proposal: label the control "Run connectivity checks (recommended)" and add one-line clarifier: "Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from our health-checker IPs. No credentials or commands are sent."

omar (Eng): implementation notes: probe sequence = TCP handshake -> SSH port probe -> optional HTTP GET. originates from a stable set of IPs (will paste CIDRs). currently IPv4 only; we'll flag IPv6-only setups as unsupported for automatic checks.

rita (Design): can we show discrete status chips for each probe type (TCP · SSH · HTTP) with icons and hover tooltips? on fail show a single-line remediation and a link to a simple troubleshooting drawer. less modal text.

lena (Product): policy: default toggle OFF for private/on-prem, ON for hosted. also add two CTAs: "Run checks from Redwood (recommended)" and "Download local probe (manual)". the download option is important for customers that cannot allow our IPs.

chao (UX): accessibility: provide aria-describedby on the toggle that states probe behavior and that no credentials are used. use a polite live region for status updates: "Connectivity checks running", then final state plus suggested next step. Make the troubleshooting link keyboard-focusable.

omar (Eng): local probe plan: small script that performs the same handshakes and posts results to a signed, time-limited URL. script will redact any local config before upload. logs returned from hosted probe will avoid storing secrets.

rita (Design): suggested microcopy (compact):

"Run connectivity checks (recommended)"
"Redwood will attempt a plain TCP handshake from our health-checker IPs to the host and port you provide. No credentials or commands are sent. If you prefer, download a local probe to run inside your network."

Inline error example:
"SSH check failed — timed out connecting to bastion.internal:22. Verify outbound rules for Redwood's health-checker IPs or run the local probe."

Success pill: "Connectivity checks passed" (green)

chao (UX): keyboard behavior: pressing Enter while focused on the toggle should start the run and move focus into a status region with role=status. screen reader should announce interim + final results. Add a small, visible progress state for long-running checks.

omar (Eng): i'll add an API flag `probe_mode` and return a `probe_summary` list so the UI can render chips and expanded logs when requested. will also publish the health-checker CIDRs in the docs and a short privacy paragraph we can link.

lena (Product): please avoid the term "allowlist" in UX; use "permitted IPs" or "allowed IPs" in copy. also i'll note in the spec that the default toggle states differ by deployment type.

infra-bot: staging deploy scheduled 2025-11-14T04:00Z — heads up. :rocket:

lena (Product): thanks all — rita, ping when mocks are up; omar, drop the CIDRs + privacy blurb here when ready.
